title: sesamum indicum subsp. malabaricum
intro: Sesamum indicum subsp. malabaricum, commonly known as the Malabar sesame, is a plant species within the Sesamum genus. It is a perennial herb native to India and Southeast Asia, known for its medicinal properties and oil-rich seeds. The health benefits of Malabar sesame include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesamin, sesamolin, and sesamol, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties.
